known_limitations: Only20 training portraits; narrow monochrome clerical-shirt framing and background range
Multiple close synthetic face-family variants were excluded; visual grouping is not biometric uniqueness proof
Few balding faces, little extreme old age and no deliberate coverage balance; apparent demographic coverage is not verified identity data
New prompt descriptors are requested generation attributes, not sensitive inferences about teacher images

training.objective: ordinary noise-prediction LoRA adaptation; not ADD re-distillation
training.image_preprocessing: resize native square to512; no random crop, flip, color jitter or synthetic image additions
training.step_semantics: total optimizer updates, not additional updates per checkpoint
stop_on: native image face quality regression or identity collapse at development gate
training.checkpoint20_role: compatibility smoke, check finite gradients/actual changed adapter tensors/loadability and development images; low loss alone does not pass
training.checkpoint100_role: bounded visual learning check before continuation
training.checkpoint250_role: last permitted pilot checkpoint; no extra updates or learning-rate/rank sweep within this protocol
training.risk: A low LR and low-rank adapter may reduce but do not remove the risk that ordinary score fine-tuning damages the distilled one-step behavior.

secondary.allowed_only_if: All adapted one-step candidates fail the frozen development gate. Run base and all completed adapted checkpoints on all24 development cases; choose once from development; label primary failure. No two/three-step search.

noise.initial_generation: torch.randn with CPU torch.Generator.manual_seed(case seed), float32; persist noise.npz and hash before any arms
noise.legacy_initial: Reuse hash-verified existing noise.npz byte values
noise.generator_handling: After generating or reconstructing the initial noise, save the CPU generator state; reset identical state for every arm. Record state hashes. Four-step Euler ancestral draws must also match; initial noise alone is insufficient.
noise.execution: cast same initial tensor to fp16 on execution device; pin software/device; compare matched arms on one device

inference.arm_policy: All four arms on24 development cases for each completed checkpoint; reuse freshly matched base arms across checkpoints. All four arms on32 tests only for the selected frozen checkpoint/step count.
inference.retain: Every raw native RGB PNG, initial latent, generator-state hash, complete prompt, tokenization/truncation diagnostics, adapter/base/software hashes, scheduler config, run timing and unmodified failure records. No best-of, face repair, crop, prompt retry or output selection.
inference.display: Optional monochrome WebP quality90 method4 for site parity, preserving raw native RGB PNG. Review both native and display; grayscale is not a repair.

review.unit: each output individually at native512 and intended display size; contact sheet only for cross-image comparisons
review.blind_if_possible: Randomize model-arm display ordering with a recorded mapping; reviewer must see every output
review.face_integrity_definition: coherent pupils/irises/eyelids, natural mouth/teeth where visible, plausible anatomy and facial detail without smeared/doubled features
review.collar_definition: recognizable legitimate white clerical collar; exact small Roman tab is a prompt-match diagnostic only, not a user quality gate
review.joint_pass: all six pass: face_integrity, photographic_texture, recognizable_clerical_clothing, adult_male_appearance, bareheaded, single_person. Uncertain counts as not passed.
set_labels: conservative visual face-family assignments with notes
number of distinct plausible face families
strong resemblance to training or heldout teachers
paired wins/ties/losses for photographic priest quality and calendar appeal

development_candidate_gate.scope: engineering go/no-go heuristic, not user approval or a statistically proven quality threshold
development_candidate_gate.calendar_appeal_nonregression: paired calendar-appeal wins must be at least losses against base-trigger; ties allowed
development_candidate_gate.no_passing_checkpoint_action: report pilot failure; consider secondary four-step only as specified, then stop if still no pass

review.checkpoint_selection: Among passing development checkpoints, maximize joint_pass then face_integrity then distinct face families then paired calendar appeal net wins; exact tie selects earlier checkpoint. Freeze choice and all labels before test generation.

test_success_descriptive_gate.result: report paired counts and every failed image; passing is a research candidate, not production approval

review.after_test: No prompt edits, seed replacement, label refinements, adapter-scale change, checkpoint change or reopening250 updates based on these test results. A revised experiment gets a new protocol and fresh disjoint seeds; retain this failed/successful record.

report: warm generation including conditioning and VAE
queueing and public request latency separately
latency.production_gate: Measure complete server pipeline on intended hardware including any future filtering/retries and encoding; uncurated pilot latency does not establish that gate.

sources.supports: ADD-distilled1–4-step model, guidance0, preferred512, acknowledged face/photorealism limitations; does not promise ordinary LoRA preserves distillation
